table.title: Equivalent R and SPSS syntax
rows:
df <- read.csv("review-survey.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c('', 'NA', 'null', 'NULL'))
library(survival)
items <- c("A", "B", "C", "D")
set_cols <- c("set_0", "set_1", "set_2", "set_3")
best <- as.character(df$best)
long_id <- integer(0); long_y <- integer(0); long_item <- character(0)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
  alts <- unique(as.character(unlist(df[i, set_cols, drop=FALSE])))
  alts <- alts[alts %in% items]
  for (a in alts) {
    long_id <- c(long_id, i)
    long_y <- c(long_y, as.integer(a == best[i]))
    long_item <- c(long_item, a)
  }
}
ref <- items[length(items)]
rest <- items[-length(items)]
long <- data.frame(id=long_id, y=long_y, item=factor(long_item, levels=c(ref, rest)))
fit <- clogit(y ~ item + strata(id), data=long)
cf <- coef(fit)
cat(sprintf('u1=%.16g\n', unname(cf[1])))
